verdict.rationale: PayPal documents a dedicated sandbox that mirrors production, allowing developers/agents to test agent-toolkit tools, cart API, and checkout flows without touching live accounts, and confirms the same REST rails (Orders, cart API) run against sandbox credentials. Missing for 10: no independent/hands-on verification of sandbox parity for agentic-commerce-specific flows (cart API, ACP/UCP checkout) and no explicit documentation of sandbox mode for the MCP server or agent toolkit specifically.
